research:
Lines: AP preview MEM -1.5, o/u 242.5; Bleacher Nation UTA +1.5, 240.5, MEM ML -120 (54.5%); DocSports MEM -1.5, 241.5; SportsGambler 1.5 / 240.5; Dimers (Oct 15 snapshot) had UTA -2.5, 242.5, UTA -125 / MEM +114, so the line flipped to Memphis.
Experts: Bleacher Nation MEM -1.5 and ML; DocSports UTA +1.5; SI Peter's Points UTA ML -102 (upset pick); Dimers model UTA 58%, but its best bet is MEM ML -115 (3.0% edge). Split.
Starters (SportsGambler, Oct 21): UTA Filipowski, George, Jackson Jr., Peterson (No. 2 pick 2026), Markkanen; MEM Jerome, Grant, Edey, Coward, Boozer (rookie).
Injuries: UTA out Trey Alexander, Tony Bradley, Blake Hinson, Jusuf Nurkic. MEM Isaiah Stewart doubtful (ankle); GG Jackson off the report (CBS).
Roster changes: Memphis completed a rebuild (Morant, Bane and JJJ traded over two offseasons) around Boozer and Coward, adding Grant (from POR) and Jerome. Utah has JJJ for a full season after a mid-2025-26 trade (knee surgery ended his year Feb 12).
2025-26: UTA 22-60 (worst defense, ~126 ppg allowed); MEM 25-57 (114.7 ppg for, 120.7 against, opp. rebounds 2nd-most).
Usage (2025-26): George 29.1% (Cleaning the Glass, 46 g), Markkanen 24.1% CTG (RotoWire 28.1%), JJJ 26.2% (CraftedNBA, season unlabeled), Grant 23.6% (Screwball), Jerome only 15 games (19.7 ppg in 22.6 min). Peterson is a rookie, so he has no sample.
DvP (Legion Report 2025-26, DK, rank 1 = most): MEM G 12th, F 3rd, C 16th; UTA G 1st, F 5th, C 3rd. RotoGrinders' undated sheet has UTA 27-30 at every spot, which contradicts its 2025-26 worst-defense status, so Legion Report is used.
SGP (93% normal approx, logs not reachable): Markkanen 14+ pts ~0.93, 3+ reb ~0.94; JJJ 8+ pts ~0.93. Raw 0.81, shrunk to 0.74 for role changes, JJJ's knee and correlation. Estimated implied ~0.725 (~-265). Not highlighted, because the gap is smaller than the price uncertainty.
Totals (USU MACFAX adj.): UTA 112.3/120.9 pace 105.7; MEM 110.5/117.6 pace 104.5; avg poss 105.1. MEM 121.6 + UTA 120.8 = 242.4 vs 240.5-242.5, so there is no total edge. Margin MEM +0.8 plus ~2 home court = MEM ~2.8 vs -1.5.
Caveat: both rosters changed heavily, so last season's team ratings are only a weak guide; both teams play fast (top-5 pace).
Props: Markkanen pts 21.5 (o-114/u-120 SportsGambler), well under his 26.7 ppg; George pts 20.5 (o-109), ast 6.5 (o-108/u-128); Dimers likes Coward o5.5 reb +122 and o13.5 pts (Polymarket).
Markkanen 2025-26: 26.7/6.9/2.1 in 42 games (34.4 min, hip injury late); George 23.6/3.7/6.1 in 54 games; Coward 13.6/5.9/2.8 in 62 games.
Coaching: Will Hardy plays young lineups and a deep bench; Memphis's new core is young and fast-paced. Neither team has a back-to-back.
